text:
elaine: Heads up — prod keystore rollout (new KMS policy) started in eu-west-1, and we're seeing GPU node bootstrap failures in the warm pool. Nodes stuck at 'decrypting root' from keystore proxy.

kumar: seeing same. error from keystore-proxy: `403 AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt` in logs.

nina: this started right after the egress FW change last night (default deny + privatelink-only). Are bootstrap replicas allowed to reach the KMS endpoints?

sam: ops-bot triggered: canary failed on 2/5 boots — fallback to old keystore config applied automatically.

ops-bot: [alert] canary: keystore-decrypt-failure count=2 region=eu-west-1 service=warm-pool

elaine: possible cause: IAM role boundary update removed cross-account kms:Decrypt for ephemeral node role. Rolling back policy now.

kumar: if we rollback, we need to patch the firewall too — NAT GW is currently blocked for the warm pool subnets. That was the change to save NAT cost.

jordan: cost tradeoff: NAT GW savings ~ $1.8k/month but hitting provisioning means lost capacity and SLA risk. Recommend temporary NAT allowance for bootstraps + monitor.

nina: can we instead add a VPC endpoint for KMS? PrivateLink for KMS would avoid NAT but we'd need to add route table + endpoint policy — small infra change.

sam: I prefer endpoint. Quicker than changing IAM across accounts and less blast radius than opening NAT. Who can do endpoint policy?

elaine: I can create the endpoint but need the endpoint policy and SG rules. Sharing current fetch:
``
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --service-name com.amazonaws.eu-west-1.kms \
  --vpc-id vpc-xxxx --subnet-ids subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb --security-group-ids sg-boot
```

kumar: endpoint policy must allow `kms:Decrypt` from `arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/ephemeral-node-*`

nina: also we should enable KMS audit logging for this endpoint path — CloudTrail already has kms events but sample rate might drop. Need high-fidelity for rollout.

jordan: ops checklist: 1) create endpoint + policy 2) add route to warm pool subnets 3) re-run canary 4) monitor healers. I'll own 3/4.

elaine: creating endpoint now in eu-west-1, will post endpoint id.

ops-bot: [deploy] infra-change-1729502468 started by elaine

elaine: endpoint created id: vpce-0abc123de45

kumar: applying endpoint policy now. policy snippet:
``
{
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"*","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringLike":{"aws:PrincipalArn":"arn:aws:iam::*:role/redwood-ephemeral-node-*"}}}]
}
```

sam: after policy applied, re-triggering warm-pool join canary.

ops-bot: [canary] warm-pool-join trigger by sam

nina: canary logs look good so far, decrypt succeeded on 3/3 boots.

elaine: rolling to 50% of warm pool; keeping NAT GW block in place for other subnets.

jordan: monitoring metrics: capacity join rate up, provision latency back to baseline. cost calc: temporary small VPC endpoint data-processing fees vs NAT savings — ok.

kumar: followup tasks: 1) document endpoint policy + audit config 2) add integration test to ensure kms decrypt works without NAT 3) schedule IAM role boundary review next week.

elaine: I'll open a PR for docs and link runbook.

sam: thanks everyone. postmortem not needed if we keep docs & test. :thumbsup:
